subject: MAP: Environment handoff — API keys, org setup, IP allowlist & VPC peering
messages:
From: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@medtrust.com>
To: naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@medtrust.com
Date: 2026-07-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: POC MAP — Next steps for environment handoff

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team liked the latency numbers. Procurement asked me to document the technical handoff tasks we discussed and confirm timelines so they can align with our internal IT change window. High level we need:

- Org & user provisioning (service account + SSO connection)
- API key issuance and rotation policy for the POC
- IP allowlist for outbound calls from Redwood hosts
- VPC peering request and estimated maintenance window

Can you send a short MAP with owners, expected durations, and any templates we should fill? We aim to get the POC live in our staging VPC the week of July 19th.

Appreciate it,

Sofia Ramos
Senior Product Manager, Integrations
MedTrust Health

Attachments: none
From: naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@medtrust.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-07-01T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC MAP — Next steps for environment handoff

Sofia — thanks for the clear list. Attached is a one-page MAP (MAP_activities_v1.2.pdf) and two templates: an IP allowlist CSV and a VPC peering request workbook. Summary below with owners and proposed dates so you can share with procurement/IT: 

1) Org & user provisioning (owner: Naomi Feldman) — 2 business days
   - Create staging org, invite service-account user, request SSO SAML metadata
   - Deliverable: org-id and service-account email

2) API keys & rotation (owner: Marissa Cole) — 1 business day
   - We will generate POC keys scoped to generation & eval endpoints; keys expire in 30 days by default
   - Deliverable: key_id, instructions for rotation, recommended RBAC

3) IP allowlist (owner: Mateo Alvarez) — 1 business day to produce list; your IT to confirm inbound rules
   - Attached: ip_allowlist_template.csv (fill column A with CIDR / column B purpose)

4) VPC peering (owner: Mateo Alvarez) — planning + request 3–5 business days depending on cloud approvals
   - Attached: vpc_peering_request_filled.xlsx — please populate the left column with your VPC ids and IOPS expectations

Target milestones:
- July 6: templates returned from MedTrust (IP CSV + VPC IDs + SSO metadata)
- July 9: Redwood issues API keys and staging org details
- July 12–16: VPC peering window (tentative; can be scheduled later if change window conflicts)
- Week of July 19: POC smoke tests in staging environment

Can you confirm the July 6 template return and whether IT requires any additional artifacts (SOC link, contact for peering ticket)? I can copy our infra engineer on the peering call if needed.

Thanks — I attached the MAP and templates.

—
Naomi Feldman
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0132
Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP_activities_v1.2.pdf; ip_allowlist_template.csv; vpc_peering_request_filled.xlsx
From: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@medtrust.com>
To: naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@medtrust.com
Date: 2026-07-01T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC MAP — Next steps for environment handoff

Thanks Naomi — that looks great and actionable. A couple of quick clarifications from IT/procurement: 

- For the API keys: procurement wants the key rotation cadence documented and whether HSM-backed signing is available for production (POC can use standard keys). Can Marissa supply a 1-paragraph note we can include in the MSA appendix?
- For peering: our networking team wants an expected CIDR overlap check and who is the point of contact at Redwood to accept the peering request (name + email + escalation phone).

We'll aim to return the completed CSV and VPC ids by July 6. If you can provide the peering POC and Marissa's note today/tomorrow that helps get approvals moving.

Sofia

Hi Sofia — quick note on the API key / HSM question. For the POC we'll provide standard scoped keys and a rotation script (runbook) — attached is a short paragraph you can paste into the MSA appendix. For production, we support KMS/HSM-backed key storage and signing; we can propose an HSM integration work order as part of the Dedicated deployment.

Peering POC at Redwood: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>, phone +1-415-555-0189. Mateo will accept the peering request and coordinate the maintenance window with your network team. He'll also run an overlap/CIDR check once you provide VPC IDs.

Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: API_key_rotation_paragraph.txt
